-- https://discord.gg/8wSP7XedR8
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character

local Comm = require(ReplicatedStorage.ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Comm)
local CombatService = Comm.ClientComm.new(game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteServices, false, "CombatService"):BuildObject()

local function autoAttack()
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local mobs = {}
    for _, mob in CollectionService:GetTagged("Mob") do
        if mob:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local humanoid = mob.Humanoid
            if humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (mob:GetPivot().Position - character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= 50 then
                    table.insert(mobs, mob)
                    if #mobs >= 5 then break end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #mobs > 0 then
        CombatService:UseWeapon(1, mobs, 1, nil)
    end
end

while true do
    wait(0.1)
    autoAttack()
end
